The '''GAR Destroyer''' was a small aquatic [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used destroy enemy vessels and shore emplacements. The destroyer accomplished this tasks with weapon systems similar to [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]] of the era.
